kind: container workflow engine and programmable agent runtime

runtime.execution: Engine evaluates typed content-addressed DAG objects; session agent registry runs detached Go loops and container/module/MCP actions.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns session agent/control registry, build execution, services and telemetry; consumes model providers and host/remote resources. Its service management must not become Arconaut governance of shared computation.

summary: Typed immutable conversations with actual continuation tools and addressable live agents; execution cache/archives are separate from durable external-effect settlement.

inspection.scope: LLM step/provider/tool schedule, agent mailbox/lifecycle/reseed, typed container/service actions, recording comparison, trace inspection, archive restore and direct tests
inspection.limits: Source-only; no execution. No exhaustive cache/BuildKit conformance or cloud archive review; API is explicitly experimental.

actions.name: LLM.step / loop
actions.input: immutable conversation, maxTokens/maxSteps and bound module/MCP tools
actions.output: next LLM object ID, protocol results/errors, usage/trace
actions.lifecycle: step provider+tools; loop until no pending input; completed prefix returned on cancel
actions.authority: caller capabilities and allowed module/provider policy

actions.name: module tool returning LLM (continuation)
actions.input: injected current conversation plus authored transform program
actions.output: new model/tools/workspace/history continued by same agent
actions.lifecycle: runs after ordinary mutations, one continuation per turn; validates tools and missing state
actions.authority: bound callable module has substantial control of next conversation

actions.name: LLM.spawn / agent(handle)
actions.output: unique agent runtime handle and immutable object recipe
actions.lifecycle: inert until send/resume; live entry per session; restoration preserves identity
actions.authority: handle capability; restoration refuses existing collision and live-state fiction

actions.name: Agent.send / AgentMessage.ref,delivery,response
actions.input: target handle, text/media, optional replyTo mailbox ref
actions.output: permanent #N message record; actual delivery evidence and correlated reply
actions.lifecycle: nonblocking enqueue; response waits; failed pending records can retry after resume
actions.authority: sender derived from caller context; wait graph refuses self/cycles

actions.name: Agent.notify / wait
actions.input: target/subscriber handle and state list or desired/settled state
actions.output: attributed lifecycle messages or state result
actions.lifecycle: subscription active across transitions; waits cancelable, settled includes failure/stop
actions.authority: known agent handles and cycle guard

actions.name: Agent.pause(interrupt) / resume / stop
actions.output: paused/stopped snapshot or relaunched same entry
actions.lifecycle: interrupt cancels current step; consumed input remains pending, queued mail discarded; stop ends loop
actions.authority: capability-bound handle access; does not undo external effects

actions.name: Agent.reseed
actions.input: same runtime handle and replacement LLM conversation
actions.output: same instance with changed committed snapshot; old consumed prompt receives rewind error
actions.lifecycle: refuses active step/drain/stopped instance; next queued turn uses replacement
actions.authority: caller with handle and new LLM can replace history/model/tools

actions.name: Container.withExec / stdout / directory
actions.output: new lazy container, joint filesystem/exec metadata, stdout
actions.lifecycle: evaluation realizes/caches outputs; not durable external transaction

actions.name: Service.start / up / stop
actions.lifecycle: uncached imperative service state; owned session lifetime
actions.authority: service handle/runtime authority; keep shared fabric consumption distinct

actions.name: LoadTrace / ReadLogs / ReadTrace / FindSpans / InspectCall
actions.output: imported root IDs, bounded logs/reports/timings/call recipe
actions.lifecycle: LoadTrace inspects only; paging/filtering needed for omitted data
actions.authority: session trace access; cloud import uses connecting client auth

actions.name: archive restore graph
actions.input: sealed trace/control roster, recipe anchors, optional focus
actions.output: inert original-handle agent graph, subscriptions and selected focus
actions.lifecycle: verify/import then rehydrate; skip named broken agents; no old active process preservation

actions.name: recording/ model SendQuery
actions.input: exported messages and incoming rendered history
actions.output: next recorded assistant response or divergence error
actions.lifecycle: replay drives real loop/tool schedule; no live model invoked

filesystem.detail: Typed directory/container/module tools compose actual code execution and joint cached outputs; arbitrary external side effects are outside DAG value identity.

processes.detail: Typed directory/container/module tools compose actual code execution and joint cached outputs; arbitrary external side effects are outside DAG value identity.

code_actions.detail: Typed directory/container/module tools compose actual code execution and joint cached outputs; arbitrary external side effects are outside DAG value identity.

persistent_kernel.detail: Long-lived services/container state can host a kernel; no standing shared interpreter heap is supplied by immutable LLM or lazy exec itself.

standing_database.detail: Trace/control/archive state is queryable infrastructure; standing application DB would be an independently consumed service, not the LLM conversation object.

workflow_programming.detail: Typed DAG module programs, explicit step/loop and ordered continuation tools compose execution; cache replay does not atomically settle remote side effects.

multi_model.detail: Each immutable LLM composition carries provider/model and can be swapped by returned-LLM continuation or same-instance reseed; different seeded agents can run concurrently.

live_collaboration.detail: Addressable agent handles, attributed FIFO mailbox/reply refs, lifecycle subscriptions and caller-injected Agent primitives support concurrent peer/parent collaboration.

concurrent_work.detail: Detached agents and concurrent readonly batches; writes in a batch sequential. Shared-state mutation order is deliberate.

steering_interrupt.detail: Mail arriving during open turn joins at step boundary. Pause is cooperative; interrupt cancels a step and parks with committed history, discarding unconsumed queue.

turn_redefinition.detail: A tool can return an entirely new LLM with tools/model/workspace/history; next step adopts it, validates new tools and records transform, with one continuation per turn.

compaction.detail: Self-compaction can return a replacement LLM; engine supports conversation transformation but inspected paths do not establish automatic faithful summarization policy.

context_repair.detail: Same-instance reseed/continuation and original trace recipes support explicit replacement/rewind; no guarantee arbitrary missing external content can be reconstructed.

original_audit.detail: Recipe/telemetry/archive retain many original events and rewind markers, but raw oversized tool return values explicitly have no retained original escape hatch; not every OS/provider byte.

audit_query.detail: Model-native LoadTrace/ReadLogs/ReadTrace/FindSpans/InspectCall query session telemetry and call recipes with bounded projections and external auth for cloud imports.

hot_change.detail: Continuation tools can carry edited/rebound workspace/tool env into same loop; reseed refuses active execution/drain. This differs from default whole-turn activation.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Archive restore rehydrates inert agents under original handles and dependency closures; old RUNNING state cannot survive. No compiled harness refit with full effect-quiescence established.

remote_services.detail: Model provider requests, container/MCP services and host tunnels are wired; service runtime owns managed containers, consuming Arconaut must respect external fabric boundary.

self_improvement.detail: Module execution/edit→continuation/reload supports in-situ program change; no inspected autonomous hypothesis/evaluator/promotion protocol.

complaints.detail: Agent failure/rewind telemetry and trace query expose diagnostics; no full-state complaint/bead workflow traced.

authority.detail: Module/tool capability binding, caller provenance and allowed-model modules; new unknown Git module model use can prompt. Handle possession addresses agent.

evaluation.detail: Inspected direct tests assert reseed race rejection, exported rewind identity, recipe closure failure and restore ordering; recording provider detects rendered-history divergence, not model reasoning quality.

time_order.detail: Mailbox refs/delivery commit, turn-resolution lock, ordered writes/parallel reads and sealed archive high-water cut distinguish causal/physical order.

evidence.claim: Spawn identity is a fresh runtime handle; immutable seed/object is separate from mutable session registry.
Step derives exposed tools, renders history, sends provider request, materializes assistant response before calling tools and captures entering bound state.
Continuation adopts returned LLM; workspace/tool changes recorded as selectors. Cancellation still records pure result history detached from cancellation before returning cause.
Readonly tool runs can execute concurrently; mutations sequential in list order; continuation tools scheduled last after earlier effects.
Only one returned-LLM continuation per turn; rejects missing/null env and unreflected state changes. New model/history/workspace/tool state is actual continuation, not merely a prompt.
Mailbox assigns monotonic per-agent refs and provenance; stopped/failed/paused/running delivery states differ; steering is only finalized on actual drain.
Loop commits each successfully recorded prefix even on cancellation; late steering serialized with turn resolution, consumed messages correlate to final reply.
Pause retains suspended turn; interrupt cancels active step, keeps consumed input pending and discards queued unconsumed mail.
Reseed replaces same agent conversation only without active step/drain, settles abandoned suspended-turn messages with rewind error and retains lifecycle identity.
Waits-for graph rejects self waits and cycles with actionable errors; non-agent callers are outside graph guard.
Tool LLM/Agent arguments resolve caller context/function-call provenance, enabling child-parent messaging without forgeable sender argument.
Public send/message/pause/resume/wait/notify/stop/reseed methods wire actual lifecycle and explicit reply refs.
withExec creates lazy joint FS/exec metadata/mount outputs, evaluated through engine cache; code action is container execution not permanent interpreter heap.
Public exec inputs check stdin conflict, clone container, dispatch owned WithExec; stdout evaluation materializes execution metadata.
Service dispatch owns container/tunnel/reverse-tunnel startup and attaches cached container under client session; separate from external resource ownership.
Public imperative start/up/stop are uncached; start health check, host tunnel and kill-vs-grace semantics are distinct.
Tool result safety cap drops middle/long lines; source explicitly says raw return value was never persisted elsewhere, unlike captured logs.
LoadTrace imports authenticated historical trace for inspection, without executing recipes or restoring agents; read-log IDs returned.
ReadTrace inspect/timings/report and FindSpans query session trace; tool reports are filtered/bounded projections.
Git modules need allowed-model capability or operator prompt; local/nonmodule requests allowed; this is configurable authority rather than command approval on every action.
Restore orders parents first, resolves anchors and subscriptions, skips unrestorable entries explicitly, creates inert runtimes before adopting/prompting.
Archive roster selected from sealed witnessed revisions and fixed timestamp/high-water cut; missing implementation evidence is not reconstructed by guesses.
Recipe dependency closure checked without evaluating calls; missing/cyclic dependencies fail. Closure validation is not external-effect settlement.
Recorded provider compares model-rendered history text/roles/media identity and reports divergence; it supplies next response rather than live-provider correctness oracle.
Rewind marker preserves from/to recipe digests and original trace visibility; best-effort event, not removal of old telemetry.
Public skills/MCP/step/loop/spawn surfaces; restoring explicit handles refuses RUNNING/WAITING_INPUT because old process died.

tests.oracle: Exact old snapshot and unresolved message preserved on reject; after drain ends replacement adopted and consumed message gets rewind error.
SpanRecorder asserts one exported rewind span and exact agent ID; proves event export under mock tracer, not archive retention.
Exact closure length and errors; truncated stream invokes zero partial callbacks. No recipes run in the oracle.
Fake destination exact call sequence requires all rehydration before address/adopt; named unrestorable entries skipped. Does not prove runtime external effects survive.
Exact authoritative patch payload/content type in log records; recorded-provider display tests preserve production nesting, not raw unbounded external return archive.

strengths: Actual tools can redefine the next conversation/program; identity-preserving reseed has race checks.
Addressable peer agents with correlated replies and wait-cycle refusal closely match sophisticated collaboration needs.
Trace-native query and inert archive restore make continuity inspectable.
limits: Go engine is a studied reference, not an architecture choice.
Raw oversized tool result originals are not retained; cache/recipe closure does not settle external effects.
Experimental session-agent restore is not compiled refit or ongoing provider/process migration.
arconaut_questions: Can continuation-as-return-value make arbitrary turn programs model-ergonomic without monolithic policy?
What changes from step-boundary Dagger activation to the operator-selected default turn/workflow conclusion?
How should independent shared services be addressed without importing engine service governance?
Can every tool/provider original survive separately from bounded context and rendered telemetry?
